package.description: Command-line interface for DevOps Shield compliance assessment and policy management.

en-US.description: Command-line interface for DevOps Shield compliance assessment and policy management.
en-US.longDescription:
The DevOps Shield CLI runs compliance assessments, manages policies and
exemptions, inspects resource inventory, and exports findings as SARIF or
JSON against Azure DevOps, GitHub, and GitLab. It talks to a DevOps Shield
API host, which you can run locally with Docker Compose or in Kubernetes.
en-US.name: DevOps Shield CLI
